finding.summary:
```suggestion
  nosource="${4-}"
```
assignments won't work if there's spaces around the =

label: real_issue
label_reason: A human reviewer raised this in nvm-sh/nvm#2439 (merged 2021-02-28), and a later commit in the PR changes the file.
notes: Hand-picked with Claude Code (PMAT-310): https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm/pull/2439. Bash: spaces around `=` make this a command, not an assignment. Human reviewers are not perfect ground truth, and they give no severity, so any severity counts.
